blocks.text: Answers 1–6: 1. Total distance around a shape. 2. Correct trapezium with exactly one marked pair of parallel opposite sides. 3. Correct labelled parallelogram with two pairs of parallel opposite sides. 4. Any two: four equal sides, opposite sides parallel, diagonals perpendicular, opposite angles equal. 5. Correct non-rhombus kite with its symmetry diagonal. 6. Area measures two-dimensional surface; volume measures three-dimensional space.
